status: exploratory source-grounded rule audit; not preregistered or a held-out NLP benchmark
question: 지원금 상한이 같을 때, 바뀐 조건은 어떤 가상 사례의 판독을 바꾸는가?
relation: annual program versions, not an erratum pair
unit: one historical program / two notices / one version pair
formalization: AI-assisted manual reading of official full attachments; no automatic rule extraction
interpretation_policy: Preserve the published housing table and a candidate 1000-KRW-floor reading separately. If decisions differ, abstain on the housing component. This does not establish an error in the official notice.
population_claim: None. Identical fictional inputs are projected onto selected rule fragments, not a person's historical eligibility or actual outcomes.
controls: carry old welfare exclusions into new version
metrics: counts over the fixed grid, raw traces, disagreement with declared formalization; not measured model accuracy or population effects
future_evaluation: freeze new event-level document pairs and an annotation guide before independent dual annotation; assess extraction, entailment and scenario outcomes separately
